items.q: He was, he was pretty bad. I think he played drums too. ... He was in a bad gang.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: we used to let Black Benny play bass drum

ctx.x: I used to play bass drum most of the time, but when we were in the big band up, I'd play alto. Finally, I got, we used to let Black Benny play bass drum. Yeah. You heard of him, didn't you? Oh, yes. Yeah.
Yeah. Right Benny was playing. Armstrong, this Armstrong's always talking about. Yeah.
